import os, sys, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp
sys.path.insert(0, "/tmp/obench-cell-l0epdwh5/bench_opencode_torch-tensor-parallelism_6kgeq8pt")
from parallel_linear import ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear
def run(rank, ws, port):
    os.environ["MASTER_ADDR"]="127.0.0.1"; os.environ["MASTER_PORT"]=str(port)
    dist.init_process_group("gloo", rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    I,O=8,16
    W=torch.randn(O,I); x=torch.randn(3,5,I)
    for cls, ax in [(ColumnParallelLinear,0),(RowParallelLinear,1)]:
        ref=torch.nn.Linear(I,O); 
        with torch.no_grad(): ref.weight.copy_(W); ref.bias.zero_()
        m=cls(I,O,True,W)
        xr=x.clone().requires_grad_(); xm=x.clone().requires_grad_()
        yr=ref(xr); ym=m(xm)
        assert torch.allclose(yr,ym,atol=1e-5)
        yr.pow(2).sum().backward(); ym.pow(2).sum().backward()
        assert torch.allclose(m.weight.grad, ref.weight.grad.chunk(ws,ax)[rank],atol=1e-4)
        bg = ref.bias.grad.chunk(ws)[rank] if ax==0 else ref.bias.grad
        assert torch.allclose(m.bias.grad,bg,atol=1e-4)
        assert torch.allclose(xm.grad,xr.grad,atol=1e-4)
    if rank==0: print("ok ws",ws)
    dist.destroy_process_group()
if __name__=="__main__":
    for i,ws in enumerate([1,2,4]): mp.spawn(run,args=(ws,29600+i),nprocs=ws)
